name: form

files.content:
<script lang="ts" generics="S extends z.ZodType">
	import type { z } from "zod";
	import type { Props } from "./index.js";
	const { form, children, class: className, ...props }: Props<S> = $props();
</script>

<!-- Form element; the schema replaces the browser's own validation messages. -->
<form class={["form not-typeset", className]} novalidate onsubmit={form.submit} aria-busy={form.submitting || undefined} {...props}>
	{@render children()}
</form>

<script lang="ts">
	import { useFieldCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	import type { ControlProps, ControlAttrs } from "./index.js";
	const { children }: ControlProps = $props();
	const ctx = useFieldCtx();
	const controlProps: ControlAttrs = $derived({
		id: ctx.controlId,
		name: ctx.name,
		"aria-invalid": ctx.errors.length > 0 || undefined,
		"aria-describedby": ctx.describedBy,
		onblur: () => ctx.touch(),
	});
</script>

<!-- Hands the id, name, and aria attributes to the control rendered by the child. -->
{@render children({ props: controlProps })}

<script lang="ts">
	import { FieldDescription, type FieldDescriptionProps } from "#lib/components/ui/field/index.js";
	import { useFieldCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	import type { Attachment } from "svelte/attachments";
	const props: FieldDescriptionProps = $props();
	const ctx = useFieldCtx();

	/** Marks the description as mounted so the control is described by it. */
	const registerDescription: Attachment = () => {
		ctx.hasDescription = true;
		return () => (ctx.hasDescription = false);
	};
</script>

<!-- Helper text that describes the field's control. -->
<FieldDescription id={ctx.descriptionId} {@attach registerDescription} {...props} />

<script lang="ts">
	import { FieldError, type FieldErrorProps } from "#lib/components/ui/field/index.js";
	import { useFieldCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	const props: Omit<FieldErrorProps, "errors"> = $props();
	const ctx = useFieldCtx();
</script>

<!-- The field's errors, once the user has left it or tried to submit. -->
<FieldError id={ctx.errorId} errors={ctx.errors} {...props} />

<script lang="ts" generics="S extends z.ZodType">
	import type { z } from "zod";
	import { Field } from "#lib/components/ui/field/index.js";
	import { setFieldCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	import type { FieldItemProps } from "./index.js";
	const { form, name, children, ...props }: FieldItemProps<S> = $props();
	const baseId = $props.id();
	// Getters keep the context reading the current form and name after setup.
	const ctx = setFieldCtx({ name, baseId, getErrors: () => form.errorsFor(name), touch: () => form.touch(name) });

	// Keep the name current when the prop changes.
	$effect.pre(() => void (ctx.name = name));
</script>

<!-- Field that turns invalid while its value has shown errors. -->
<Field invalid={ctx.errors.length > 0} {...props}>
	{@render children()}
</Field>

<script lang="ts">
	import { FieldLabel, type FieldLabelProps } from "#lib/components/ui/field/index.js";
	import { useFieldCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	const props: FieldLabelProps = $props();
	const ctx = useFieldCtx();
</script>

<!-- Label pointing at the field's control. -->
<FieldLabel for={ctx.controlId} {...props} />

description: Form state checked by a zod schema, with fields that show their errors and wire up labels and aria attributes.
